mechanism: A repeatable narrow line-of-sight deformation gradient across coherent interferometric pairs can mark localized slip or fluid-driven deformation along a structure. Opposing orbit geometries may help distinguish vertical from east-west displacement; this is not a direct fault observation.
named_non_fault_mimic: Groundwater-withdrawal compaction or atmospheric delay; decorrelation and orbital ramps are additional measurement artifacts.
